query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, co.id as contact_id, co.firstName, co.lastName, ccr.companyId, ccr.contactId 
FROM companies c 
LEFT JOIN contactCompanyRelations ccr ON ccr.companyId = c.id 
LEFT JOIN contacts co ON co.id = ccr.contactId 
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Robert Bosch%Deutschland%' 
LIMIT 20
